I need to find the concrete SQL INSERT method for memos under default installation. Multiple database drivers exist, so I must determine which driver is active and identify the exact executing code.

I will check profile defaults, CLI flags, and memo Create methods to identify the default driver and the exact INSERT implementation.
I'll find the default DB driver and the concrete memo INSERT that runs when no database flags are set.
Checking the default value of the driver flag to identify the active database backend.

The default driver is SQLite. This is set by viper and the --driver flag in cmd/memos/main.go.

NewDBDriver selects sqlite.NewDB based on the default driver profile. Store.CreateMemo delegates to driver.CreateMemo. sqlite.DB.CreateMemo executes the INSERT. The path is CLI default → factory switch → sqlite.CreateMemo.

The concrete method is `(*DB).CreateMemo` in `store/db/sqlite/memo.go`. Default installation uses the SQLite driver, set in `cmd/memos/main.go`.

`NewDBDriver` in `store/db/db.go` selects `sqlite.NewDB` for the default SQLite driver. `Store.CreateMemo` dispatches to `driver.CreateMemo`, so `sqlite.DB.CreateMemo` executes the INSERT.

h12.
`sqlite.DB.CreateMemo` — `store/db/sqlite/memo.go`; default `driver` is `"sqlite"` in `cmd/memos/main.go`, selected by `NewDBDriver` in `store/db/db.go`

With no database flags, `viper.SetDefault("driver", "sqlite")` and `--driver` default to `"sqlite"` (`cmd/memos/main.go:122`, `:130`). `db.NewDBDriver` then calls `sqlite.NewDB` (`store/db/db.go:18–20`). Saving a memo goes `Store.CreateMemo` → `s.driver.CreateMemo` (`store/memo.go:109–113`). MySQL and Postgres also implement `CreateMemo`, but they are not constructed on that default path, so the INSERT that runs is `sqlite.DB.CreateMemo` (`INSERT INTO \`memo\` …` at `store/db/sqlite/memo.go:16–51`).
